title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 2. Welcomes the appointment of a coordinator for combating anti-Muslim hatred and calls on the coordinator and the Commission to establish synergies with civil society organisations (CSOs) that have extensive knowledge of the issue, as well as with academic experts, affected communities and all other relevant stakeholders, by conducting periodic consultation meetings and ensuring their meaningful participation in the decision-making process while upholding the principle of transparency;
